free_tier.stated: Conflicting. The live UGS pricing page lists Cloud Content Delivery 'Cloud Storage — Free'. A third-party writeup of the same product reports 5 GB/month included. Unresolved; treat as small until an account test settles it.

retention.stated: per-object-cap: entry upload bounded by the storage allowance; request-rate: API requests currently unlimited/free; per-ip-shaping: none documented. Retention: releases are immutable snapshots, kept until deleted — good archive semantics if the quota is real.

egress.terms: Metered after a small free allowance: 'Bandwidth (CCD) 50 GB / month. After 50 GB: $0.08 per GB, After 50 TB: $0.06 per GB'. Fails the 500 GB/day serving workload by a factor of ~10 per month.

tooling: UGS CLI (`ugs ccd ...`), Content Delivery Management API and Client API, plus the CCD Management SDK. Releases are content-addressed: entries carry an md5 content hash and size that must match on upload.
chaining: Buckets per environment x releases per bucket x promotion between buckets. Note: 'Creating or promoting a new release does not create copies of the entries in a bucket' — promotion is a pointer, not a copy, so it does NOT multiply storage.
